title: Kickoff doesn't have a widget-specific shortcut set, and its config window doesn't mention its KWin-provided shortcut, which confuses people
line: An application launcher's Keyboard Shortcuts page now shows the global shortcut that opens it (Meta, Alt+F1 by default), with a button to change it.
explanation: Meta and Alt+F1 open the launcher through plasmashell's global "Activate Application Launcher" shortcut, which picks the launcher on the active screen, so the widget's own shortcut stays unset and its Keyboard Shortcuts page only said "None". Users then tried to set Meta there and got a conflict warning. For widgets that provide org.kde.plasma.launchermenu (Kickoff, Kicker, Dashboard), the Shortcuts page now reads that global shortcut from kglobalaccel and shows it under its translated name, with a short explanation and a "Configure Global Shortcut…" button that opens System Settings at Plasma Workspace's shortcuts; it refreshes when the window is focused again.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: show the global launcher shortcut on the Shortcuts page

Launchers open with the global Activate Application Launcher shortcut,
but their Keyboard Shortcuts page only showed "None". The page now shows
that shortcut, explains it, and has a button to configure it.

BUG: 510769

media.caption: Kickoff > Configure > Keyboard Shortcuts on master: only "None", nothing about Meta
Same page with the fix: shows "Activate Application Launcher: Meta, Alt+F1", what it does, and a button to configure it

review.text: Showing the shared launcher shortcut read-only with a link to System Settings is a good answer to the confusion. The implementation is fragile, though: QML makes a raw D-Bus call to kglobalaccel and formats the key codes by writing them into a hidden KeySequenceItem, and refreshes on window focus instead of on change. Maintainers are unlikely to accept that hack.
changes: Expose the launcher's global shortcut from C++ (e.g. a property on the shell's config view or a small helper in plasma-workspace/plasma-desktop) using KGlobalAccel::self()->globalShortcut("plasmashell", "activate application launcher") and QKeySequence::toString(QKeySequence::NativeText)
Update it through KGlobalAccel::globalShortcutChanged instead of re-reading on window activation
Drop the hidden KeySequenceItem and the QML DBus call
